q: Do you offer support before I choose a PC?
a: Yes. NEXORA is designed around product guidance, compatibility questions and setup recommendations.

q: Can I build a custom PC?
a: The storefront includes a Build Your PC experience concept. A production implementation can connect it to a real inventory and configuration backend.

q: Are the prices in this demo live?
a: No. Product pricing in this project is demonstration content and must be verified before commercial publication.
The storefront includes a 30-day returns concept. A real store should publish its verified return and warranty terms before launch.
The demo focuses on US shipping. A production store should publish the exact regions, carriers and delivery estimates it supports.
